text.en:
The articles specifically listed in Annex "A" (Articles Granted
Zero Duty Under the CEPT Scheme for the AFTA) hereof, as classified under

of the Tariff and Customs Code of 1978, as amended, shall be subject
to the ASEAN CEPT rates in accordance with the schedule indicated in Column 4
of Annex "A". The ASEAN CEPT rates so indicated shall be accorded to imports
coming from ASEAN Member States applying CEPT concession to the same
product pursuant to Article 4 of the CEPT Agreement and its Interpretative Notes.
PGMA Hologram # 23717

21
SECTION 2. From the date of effectivity of this Order, all articles listed in
Annex "A" entered or withdrawn from warehouses in the Philippines
for consumption shall be imposed the rates of duty therein prescribed subiect to
compliance with the Rules of Origin as provided for in the Agreement on the CEPT
Scheme for the AFTA signed on 28 January 1992.
All presidential issuances, administrative rules and
regulations, or parts thereof, which are contrary or inconsistent with this
Executive Order are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.
SECTION 4. This Executive Order shall take effect immediately following
its complete publication in two (2) newspapers of general circulation in the
Philippines.
Done in the City of Manila, this 9thday of Janwaay, in the year of Our
Lord Two Thousand and Four.
By the President:
668.16
ALBERTO G. ROMULO
Executive Secretary
PaliA Hologram # 23718
